items.title: Actor: administrators
items.detail: Proposed logical endpoint for the source-stated actor: administrators.

items.title: DNS and Web Access Filtering Engine
items.detail: Proposed logical owner for FR-001, FR-002, NFR-001.
items.component_name: DNS and Web Access Filtering Engine
items.responsibility: The system shall implement a secure DNS and web-access filtering mechanism to protect all university users from malicious or unauthorized internet destinations. The system shall inspect DNS requests, block access to known malicious domains, apply role-based browsing policies, and provide administrators with a dashboard for reviewing blocked requests and security events. The solution shall be secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable.

items.title: Policy Management Interface
items.detail: Proposed logical owner for FR-003, NFR-001.
items.responsibility: Administrators shall be able to create, update filtering policies, allow approved exceptions, investigate repeated access attempts to blocked resources, and temporarily restrict users when suspicious behavior is detected. The solution shall be secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable.

items.title: Audit and Logging Service
items.detail: Proposed logical owner for DR-001, NFR-001.
items.responsibility: The platform shall maintain audit logs of policy changes and filtering decisions, integrate with centralized authentication, and support deployment across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices. The solution shall be secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable.
